name: ConvertTextToDateTime
label: Convert Text to DateTime
description: Converts a text representation of a date and/or time value to a DateTime value.

fields.name: TextToConvert
fields.label: Text to Convert
fields.description: The text value that will be converted to a DateTime.

fields.name: UseCustomFormat
fields.label: Use Custom Format
fields.description: If true, uses the specified format string for parsing the date/time.

fields.name: Format
fields.label: Format String
fields.description: The format string to use for parsing the date/time (e.g., 'yyyy-MM-dd').

fields.name: ResultDateTime
fields.label: Result DateTime
fields.description: Returns the resulting DateTime value after conversion.
